name: Short hop
goal: Leave the ground with a short hop every time.
why: A short hop rises about half as high as a full jump and is back on the ground much sooner. Aerials out of it reach a standing opponent, and you land before they can punish.

tutorial.what: A short hop is a jump whose button you let go of early. Press X or Y and let go before {char} leaves the ground: the jump is about half as high.
tutorial.expect: Each jump is judged the moment you leave the ground: short or full, and how many frames you held the button. Your presses show on the input display; after a miss the coach shows them frame by frame against the {J} frames of jump squat.

marks.1: X pressed: the jump squat begins. X let go on the next frame
marks.J: The squat's last frame: X is already up, so the hop is short
marks.J+1: In the air: a short hop

verdict.success: Short hop! X or Y held {held_frames}.

with a button.expect: A jump with X or Y
with a button.headline: Jumped with the stick
with a button.fix: Jump with X or Y and tap it. With the stick up, the jump lasts as long as up is held: a full hop.

released in the squat.expect: X or Y let go within {J-1} frames
released in the squat.headline: Held through the squat
released in the squat.fix: Let go of X or Y within {J-1} frames of pressing it. Still held on the squat's last frame (frame {J}), the jump is a full hop.

short hop.headline: Full hop
short hop.fix: Tap X or Y: press it and let go at once, within {J-1} frames.

parts.name: The jump squat
parts.teach: Press X once. Before {char} leaves the ground there are {J} frames of jump squat, a crouch before the jump. Whether the jump is short or full is decided in those {J} frames.

marks.1: X pressed: the jump squat begins

parts.success: A jump: {J} frames of squat, then the air.

parts.name: Tap, do not hold
parts.teach: Tap X: press it and let go within {J-1} frames, before the squat ends. Let go in time and {char} rises about half as high. Still held on the squat's last frame, it is a full hop.

marks.1: X pressed: the jump squat begins
marks.2: X let go: still in the squat
marks.J+1: In the air: a short hop, about half the height

parts.name: Every time
parts.teach: Ten short hops in a row, at your own pace. Watch the height: every hop the same.

mistakes.name: held to the top of the jump

coach.note: The jump squat is {J} frames: let go of X or Y by frame {J-1}.
